epistemicStatus.interpretation: All outcomes in this Mendeley cohort have been inspected in prior analyses. These are sensitivity and transport diagnostics on development data, not independent validation, and cannot promote a model or establish generalization beyond these two farms.

blockBootstrapAt100m.interpretation: Descriptive stability only, not a population confidence interval: 13 blocks nested in two farms.

legacyOofReconciliation.interpretation: Post-fit implementation integrity comparison only; no model selection or tuning.

groupingAudit.componentDefinition: Connected farm/field components; fields sharing an exact farm-coordinate are joined; campaign repeats remain in the same spatial block.
groupingAudit.bufferValidation: Every scored spatial fold asserted coordinate identity did not cross train/test and minimum geodesic separation met its preregistered distance.
groupingAudit.campaignValidation: Campaign train/test exact coordinate intersection was asserted empty.

limitations: Mendeley outcomes were already reviewed; none of these results are pristine validation.
The 13 spatial components are nested in two farms and the two campaigns; no population-level uncertainty is claimed.
Height and biomass are observed at the same sampling points, and measurement order relative to clipping is undocumented.
A train-range support flag does not isolate extrapolation from farm, campaign, or management shifts.
No Dryad rows, predictions, metrics, or outcomes may be read by this experiment.
